messages.text: Should we build a lightweight mobile app this quarter? A few enterprise admins asked for mobile approvals, but we don't know if it is a top-three workflow yet.
I would not commit yet. We only have three customer comments, and none of them described daily use. I want discovery calls before we choose native app versus responsive web.
Native mobile would take at least eight weeks with the current team. Responsive web changes are probably two weeks, but may not satisfy push-notification requests.
Let's not decide today. Action item: run five admin interviews and bring evidence back next Friday.
